title: athyrium brevifrons var. angustifrons
intro: Athyrium brevifrons var. angustifrons, commonly known as the Japanese lady fern, is a variety of fern that belongs to the family Athyriaceae. It is primarily used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues such as inflammation, fever, and respiratory problems. The health benefits of this plant are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties, which help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other organic compounds, although further research is needed to fully understand its pharmacological effects.
